Before you decide

Questions educators ask us.

Can I run a full test series with negative marking?

Yes. Upload questions from a DOCX file, set the timer and negative marking, and publish. Every attempt is ranked on a leaderboard students can see.

Can I teach and test in Hindi?

Yes. Your lectures, notes and questions can be in Hindi, English or any language you teach in.

Can I sell a test series separately from my course?

Yes. Each course and test series has its own price, so aspirants can buy only the mocks, only the course, or both.

How does the 14-day free trial work?

Pick the free trial in the last step. You get the Starter plan for 14 days, no card needed. After that, choose a plan to keep your academy live. Or pick a plan and pay now to go live on it straight away.

What do I pay, and when?

One yearly plan: Starter ₹6,999, Growth ₹12,999 or Pro ₹24,999 a year, plus GST. No setup fee and no monthly bill. You pay once a year, securely through Razorpay by UPI, card or netbanking.

I'm not technical. Can I really build it myself?

Yes. Everything is drag and drop. If you can use WhatsApp, you can set up your academy. If you get stuck, message us on WhatsApp.

How much of each sale do I keep?

90% on Starter, 92.5% on Growth and 95% on Pro. Your share is paid out to your bank automatically.

Do I pay extra for my own domain?

No. Connecting your domain is included on every plan. The only thing you buy separately is the domain name itself, about ₹600–1,200 a year, registered in your own name.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes, any time. Upgrades take effect when payment clears, and what you already paid this year is credited.

What happens if I do not renew?

Your academy goes offline at the end of your paid year. Your content and student data stay exportable, and renewing brings it back.
